headline: Congo Challenges US to Convert Mineral Access Into Local Investments
summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo challenged the United States to convert its privileged access to copper, cobalt, and critical minerals into completed investments creating local jobs and electricity, as Lobito railway and Grand Inga talks progressed.
why: Critical mineral supply chains and infrastructure projects like the Lobito railway are vital for global technology and energy supply, influencing geopolitical trade relations and mining capital allocation.
